method.boundary: numerical dispatch and public step separately
method.input: same accepted generic lifecycle seed for each repetition
method.shares: exclusive nested-timer attribution; inclusive observations overlap
method.timing_limitations: approximate local measurements; instrumented mean versus ordinary median differs by up to 23%; not scaling measurements

evolving_cache_experiment_note: Three evolving steps per branch; order alternates and caches are process-shared. Times show noise and warm-cache/order effects, so no whole-step speedup is claimed. All paired snapshot hashes matched.

implementation.log_cache_rounding: Immutable bounds before the original final rounding; a fresh interval performs that rounding once.
implementation.evolving_method: Five successive ordinary public steps; a sixth fresh step under cProfile. Creation and snapshot hashing excluded. Trace speedup uses sums of the five ordinary timings; call reduction uses matching sixth steps.

initial_selection.failure: Capture control detected a test-file edit after module loading; fresh rerun passed.

final_rg2b_selection.failure: New memo test compared unrounded cache bounds with rounded output; assertion corrected and fresh rerun passed.

long_history_correction.method: Isolated process: temporarily restore public result capture and 64 KiB cache for before; native owned-result binding and 8 KiB cache for after. Five ordinary evolving steps plus fresh sixth profiled step. Creation and snapshot hashes excluded. Ten-step case uses nine ordinary steps plus tenth profiled step. The long growth probe and main regression process were paused during paired timings; timings are local samples, not confidence intervals.

growth.method: successive committed public steps at fixture dt; result-size and validation instrumentation
growth.100_steps: not measured; observed growth suggests approximately 0.8 MB; not a timing prediction

long_history_correction.current_validation_policy: Native constructor performs full schema and local semantic validation once; private immediate binder retains request/state/ledger/receipt/commit/outcome comparisons. Public binder reconstructs and fully validates caller records. No retained large result payloads; global successful-payload memo remains capped at 128 entries of 8 KiB.

initial_selection.notes: One subprocess timeout occurred while its parent regression process was paused for timing isolation. One new negative-zero assertion expected V4WireError rather than the existing ValueError.

final_targeted_rerun.covers: outside-checkout resource reconstruction across three hash seeds; one native validation with cache disabled for all ten families plus hostile public mutation; oversized owned result and negative-zero publication rollback

verification.lint: No new diagnostics relative to HEAD in the five files changed by the longer-history correction. Existing findings remain.
verification.limitation: The complete 135-test selection was not repeated as one process after correcting the test-only exception expectation.

isolated_archive.method: Fresh ten-step A_OS baseline recorded before archive edits; final run uses identical fixture and operation IDs. Nine ordinary steps timed, tenth fresh step profiled. All ten snapshot hashes match. All-family sixth-step comparison uses the previous owned-result benchmark as baseline and the final five-step evolving benchmark; all 60 snapshot hashes match. Family runtime ratios are not claimed because baselines were recorded in separate sessions.
isolated_archive.scope: Archive reuse, captured receipts, lineage, component and clock facts, invalidation, asset guards and checkpoints are private to _CheckedArchive in grc_v4_lifecycle.py. The existing private binder receives owned captured tuples; public bind_step_result still reconstructs caller-supplied ledgers. No candidate or realization code changed for this archive implementation.
isolated_archive.scaling_limit: Exact inspection of exposed history, tuple/index copies and full-ledger result/evidence materialization remain O(history). Fact storage is linear in the current archive. This is removal of repeated admission and semantic checks, not constant-time stepping or proof of 100-step speedup.

broad_selection.notes: All seven errors came from two source-capture methods, including six subtest controls, rejecting the new untracked test source. No behavior assertion failed.

final_controls.covers: All archive tests (including a new hostile caller-mapping request capture regression), public result composition/audit controls and all seven source-integrity methods.

verification.source_requirement: New test file marked git intent-to-add so capture can reconstruct Git HEAD plus the complete scoped patch; no commit or staged file contents.
verification.lint: New archive test file passes; both affected production files introduce no new findings relative to HEAD.
verification.limitation: The full 254-case selection was not repeated after the public-only capture-order correction and tracking the new test source.
